exposure: rs2018736 polymorphism of the fibulin-5 gene
finding: The homozygous C allele (CC) of the rs2018736 polymorphism of the fibulin-5 gene was found to be protective against POP.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery and forceps delivery were independent predictors for POP, while cesarean delivery was protective.
birth_weight: Weight of newborn was an independent predictor for POP.
